generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Room {
  id        String        @id @default(cuid())
  name      String        @unique
  capacity  Int
  floor     String?
  createdAt DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime      @updatedAt
  bookings  Booking[]
  amenities RoomAmenity[]
}

model User {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  email     String    @unique
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  bookings  Booking[]
}

model Booking {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  roomId    String
  userId    String
  title     String
  startsAt  DateTime
  endsAt    DateTime
  status    String   @default("ACTIVE")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  room      Room     @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([roomId, startsAt])
}

model Amenity {
  id          String        @id @default(cuid())
  name        String        @unique
  description String?
  rooms       RoomAmenity[]
}

model RoomAmenity {
  roomId    String
  amenityId String
  room      Room    @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  amenity   Amenity @relation(fields: [amenityId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([roomId, amenityId])
}

	@$(MAKE) --no-print-directory setup

cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# meeting-rooms-api

REST API for booking meeting rooms.

## Requirements

Node 22 and GNU Make.

## Commands

```bash
make setup      # install dependencies and prepare the database
make dev        # run in watch mode
make test       # run the test suite
make verify     # typecheck, lint, build and test
make demo-data  # load sample rows for local browsing
```

The API listens on the port given by `PORT`, default 3000.

## Finding a free slot

Bookings occupy the half-open interval `[startsAt, endsAt)`, so a meeting may
start exactly when the previous one ends. Rather than guessing at times and
retrying on `409`, ask when a room is free.

### `GET /rooms/:roomId/availability`

| Query             | Default        | Meaning                              |
| ----------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `from`            | now            | Start of the window                  |
| `to`              | `from` + 7 days| End of the window, at most 31 days on |
| `durationMinutes` | –              | Only report gaps that fit a meeting this long |

```bash
curl "localhost:3000/rooms/$ROOM/availability?durationMinutes=60"
```

```json
{
  "roomId": "ckx…",
  "from": "2030-03-01T08:00:00.000Z",
  "to": "2030-03-01T18:00:00.000Z",
  "durationMinutes": 60,
  "slots": [
    { "startsAt": "2030-03-01T08:00:00.000Z", "endsAt": "2030-03-01T10:00:00.000Z", "durationMinutes": 120 }
  ],
  "busy": [
    { "bookingId": "ckx…", "startsAt": "2030-03-01T10:00:00.000Z", "endsAt": "2030-03-01T11:00:00.000Z" }
  ]
}
```

`slots` are the free gaps, not fixed-size candidates: a 120-minute gap can hold
any 60-minute meeting inside it.

### `GET /availability`

Same query plus `capacity`, `limit` and `offset`. Answers "which room can host
this?" by returning only rooms with at least one qualifying gap, in the usual
page envelope, at most 10 slots per room.

```bash
curl "localhost:3000/availability?durationMinutes=90&capacity=8"
```

## Conflicts carry alternatives

A `409` from `POST /bookings` names the clashing booking and offers up to three
free slots of the requested length, searched forward from the requested start
over the next 7 days. Each suggestion can be posted back as-is.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "BOOKING_CONFLICT",
    "message": "Room is already booked for this period",
    "details": {
      "conflictingBookingId": "ckx…",
      "conflictingPeriod": { "startsAt": "…T10:00:00.000Z", "endsAt": "…T11:00:00.000Z" },
      "requestedPeriod":   { "startsAt": "…T09:00:00.000Z", "endsAt": "…T10:30:00.000Z" },
      "suggestions": [
        { "startsAt": "…T11:00:00.000Z", "endsAt": "…T12:30:00.000Z" }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Booking several at once

`POST /bookings/batch` takes up to 50 bookings and applies all of them or none.

```json
{ "bookings": [ { "roomId": "…", "userId": "…", "title": "…", "startsAt": "…", "endsAt": "…" } ] }
```
